# NovaPanel v1.6.147

- Require an explicit TLS profile selection for each remote inbound target, even when the target has only one available certificate. Preserve a prior selection only while it remains valid on that target.
- Distinguish preflight, creation in progress, full success, partial success, and creation failure in the remote inbound dialog. Show concise target results and retain actionable failure details.
- Add regression coverage for explicit target certificate selection and creation status transitions.
